name: Jason Beal
occupation: Interim Big Horn County sheriff (appointed April 2026; serving until Craig R. Shidler takes office in January 2027). The Lovell Chronicle reported that he had been the lead deputy for courtroom security under Sheriff Ken Blackburn.
prior_offices: Lead deputy for courtroom security, Big Horn County Sheriff's Office (Lovell Chronicle, April 9, 2026); Interim Big Horn County sheriff (appointed by the commissioners, as reported April 9, 2026)
background: Jason Beal is the interim Big Horn County sheriff, serving until sheriff-elect Craig R. Shidler takes office in January 2027. The Lovell Chronicle reported on April 9, 2026, that commissioners voted 2-1 on the previous Friday to appoint him, that he had been the lead deputy for courtroom security under recently retired sheriff Ken Blackburn, and that County Clerk Lori Smallwood swore him in. The same newspaper later reported that he finished fourth in the August 2026 Republican primary with 405 votes.
